To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the health care information systems must be developed in a secure way and the data communication must be protected.
the use of the Internet in health care systems is an important issue and the security of data communication is a major challenge for the development of health care systems.
the use of a security architecture for health care information system is a critical issue in order to ensure data protection and confidentiality.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a system that provides a secure and effective communication channel for the data transmission between the health care provider (physician) and the patients, and between the patients.
the security issues of health care information systems and the specific security issues in the development of health care information system for Parkinson's disease patients.
the security of health care information systems and the security of data communication involved in at-home health care services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the security of information systems in the health care domain is a complex problem that requires a multidisciplinary approach.
the security measures in health care information system are not only important but also a critical issue.
the health care systems, in order to be effective, must take into account the security issues and the security measures, in order to ensure the confidentiality of the patient's data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed approach is a security approach for health information systems, from a service point of view to the population, in which the confidentiality, security and access to personal medical data is a critical region, with vast social consequences.
the development of a secure health care system for Parkinson's disease is feasible and that the proposed security measures are effective.
the security measures in health care information system are not only the technical issues but also the management and policy issues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the security issues involved are similar to those of any other information system, and that the specific security measures are the same as those of other information systems.
the security measures and data protection in health care information system should be carefully considered and implemented.
a security approach to the development of health care information systems is a must.
